movers.headline: wins **new orders and awards totalling Rs 3,526 crore** — an **EPC order for an Indian industrial plant**, domestic power transmission and distribution work, and residential buildings
signs a **Rs 563.35 crore contract with the Indian Army** for **30 Vayuastra loitering-munition sets, comprising 300 munitions**, under the Fast Track Procurement route

movers.quantum: Rs 486 cr + Rs 33 cr; ~24.0% of mcap
movers.headline: approves **Rs 486 crore for about 500 new beds at Trichy** by Q2 FY30 and **Rs 33 crore for a 91-bed Bengaluru Mother & Child unit**
sells 30% of **Texmaco Defence Technologies to Vagus Def Tech & Aerospace Fund-1 for up to Rs 200 crore**, the first **Rs 100 crore as fresh equity**

movers.quantum: Rs 105.83 cr rights issue; ~12.5% of mcap
movers.headline: fixes its rights issue at **92,03,008 shares at Rs 115, Rs 105.83 crore**, a **six-for-seven entitlement** with a **20 August record date**
approves a **capital expenditure of around Rs 100 crore to expand the Flexible Packaging Division at Kashipur**, disclosed alongside its June-quarter results
sets the record date for a **tender-offer buyback of up to 8,68,100 shares at Rs 900, Rs 78.13 crore**, approved by shareholders at its 41st AGM
approves a **rights issue of up to Rs 49.75 crore**, more than **seven-tenths of its own market value**, with the record date still to be notified

order_wins: **Transformers & Rectifiers (India)** — a letter of intent from **APTRANSCO** for transformer manufacturing, for delivery within 13 months, which the filing sizes only as a *Large Order*, the company's own band for **Rs 100–500 crore**, with no point value.

**Refex Industries** — a **slab-wise rate contract of about Rs 40.83 crore including GST from a Maharatna power producer**, to excavate pond ash and haul it to NHAI, state and PMGSY road projects over **12 months** _(~1.0% of mcap)_.

**Hazoor Multi Projects** — an NHAI letter of award to act as **user-fee collection agency at the Thirupapachethi plaza on NH-49 in Tamil Nadu** for **one year**, sized **Rs 28.47 crore** _(~4.6% of mcap)_.

**Sungarner Energies** — two letters of intent from **Ceigall India for the Madhya Pradesh KUSUM solar project**, **Rs 24.00 crore and Rs 5.30 crore**, covering land-lease services and then EPC at the Chirapatta and Chuna Hajuri sites.

**Seamec** — a consortium agreement with Supreme Hydro Engineering for **diving technical expertise on the ONGC vessel Samudra Sevak**, valued at approximately **USD 1.47 million including GST**; the filing states no rupee equivalent, so none is given here.
**Simplex Castings** — a **fabrication order worth Rs 10.80 crore from M/s Infinity Horizon** _(~2.5% of mcap)_.
**Below the bar:** **Monarch Surveyors** Rs 2.90 crore, **Desco Infratech** Rs 2.14 crore, **DMR Engineering** Rs 1.66 crore and **Admach Systems** Rs 1.59 crore.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **TD Power Systems** — approves a **preferential issue of 6,25,000 equity shares at Rs 1,200 to two promoters**, Nikhil Kumar and Mohib Nomanbhai Khericha, **Rs 75 crore** in all, subject to shareholder approval _(~0.3% of mcap)_.

**Swastika Investmart** — members approve at an extraordinary general meeting held today the issue of **90,50,000 convertible warrants at Rs 63.64, aggregating Rs 57.59 crore**, on a preferential basis _(~17.2% of mcap)_.

**Suraj Products** — the board approves **Rs 57.75 crore of convertible warrants and Rs 11.55 crore of equity, both priced at Rs 231** to non-promoters, and lifts authorised capital from Rs 12 crore to Rs 15 crore _(~22.0% of mcap on the warrant leg)_.

**Ironwood Education** approves a **rights issue of up to Rs 24 crore** _(~29.2% of mcap)_, and **Mitsu Chem Plast** **10,00,000 warrants at Rs 151, Rs 15.10 crore**, to promoters and non-promoter shareholders _(~6.8% of mcap)_.
**KCK Industries** — withdraws its approved **preferential issue of 2,50,00,000 equity shares**, investors having declined to participate; shareholders had cleared it on 3 August.
equity_allotments: **Davangere Sugar** — issues **10,64,11,079 convertible warrants at Rs 3.77, Rs 40.12 crore** preferentially, superseding the loan-conversion proposal its board approved on 28 July _(~9.3% of mcap)_.
**Vishvprabha Ventures** — approves converting **up to Rs 4.00 crore of unsecured loans into equity or convertibles**, subject to members _(~31.2% of mcap)_.

**Godavari Drugs** allotted **Rs 5.25 crore** of equity _(~5.2% of mcap)_, **Darjeeling Industries** Rs 0.25 crore, and **Borosil Renewables** filed an allotment of securities with **no rupee value stated** in the intimation.
m_and_a: **Adani Energy Solutions** — executes a share purchase agreement with **REC Power Development for 100% of Vizag Power Transmission**, a company with **Rs 5 lakh of paid-up capital** whose shares are acquired **at face value**, to build the Andhra Pradesh link.

**GTT Data Solutions** — agrees to acquire **47.47% of Antworks Solutions India for Rs 38.00 crore**, discharged entirely by issuing **77,54,506 of its own shares at Rs 49**, while rescinding three earlier resolutions on the same target _(~18.2% of mcap)_.

**Tata Steel** — transfers **100% of Jamshedpur Football & Sporting to Churchill Brothers Sports Club for a nominal Rs 100**, exiting its Indian Super League club subject to All-India Football Federation approval.

**Blue Cloud Softech — a completed acquisition, disclosed in a results note.** Its **Rs 372.81 crore all-equity swap for Global Impx Inc** was approved on 6 April, cleared by shareholders on 4 May and took effect on **17 June**, settled in 17 crore shares at Rs 21.95.

**UGRO Capital** — circulates the notices convening **separate meetings of equity shareholders and secured and unsecured creditors** for its amalgamation with **Profectus Capital**, under an **NCLT order of 6 August**; a procedural step, with no new terms.

**REC** — files the seller's side of that transaction: **Vizag Power Transmission's 50,000 shares left RECPDCL on 14 August** to the winner of the tariff-based bid, its revenue contribution stated as **negligible**.

**Voltas** — signs a **binding term sheet with Atomberg Innovation** for an Indian joint venture making **room air-conditioner compressors**; no value is stated and definitive agreements are still to come.

**Ashok Leyland** — approves **up to GBP 25 million, which the filing puts at about Rs 325 crore, of equity into Optare Plc** and **up to Rs 500 crore into Hinduja Housing Finance**, bought from Hinduja Leyland Finance.
**Jay Kailash Namkeen** — Amar Pramod Talwar opens a takeover offer for **21,76,540 shares, 26% of expanded voting capital, at Rs 56 — Rs 12.19 crore** in cash on full acceptance.
**Rainbow Children's Medicare** — completes the **64% partnership interest in Super Prime Medical Care LLP** agreed on 29 July; the filing states no consideration.
**Spandana Sphoorty** — approves amalgamating its wholly-owned **Criss Financial** into itself by scheme of arrangement, subject to NCLT.

**Bought out their own minorities:** **Greaves Cotton** took **Excel Controlinkage** to 100%, and **Physicswallah** bought NSDC International's 10% of **Bharat Innovations Global**. Neither filing states a price.
**Sugs Lloyd**, **20 Microns**, **Abhinav Capital Services** and **Kkalpana Plastick** filed acquisition or restructuring updates with **no consideration stated**.
capex_core: **Race Eco Chain** — subscribes **Rs 1.02 crore** to a rights issue of **Ganesha Recycling Chain, its own 51% subsidiary**, after which that holding is **unchanged at 51%**, so no capital enters the group.

**Smartworks Coworking Spaces** — adds **about 176,285 sq ft of capacity in Pune** to a 14.5 million sq ft leased and 10.4 million sq ft operational base, at a stated **Rs 28 crore** _(0.5% of mcap)_.
**Picturehouse Media, Indo National and Baroda Rayon carry no capital expenditure at all** — each filed a quarterly results statement, and the figures the store took are cells inside those tables.
business_updates: **Results season is the great majority of the tape** — **723 companies filed results or earnings-call material**, including **Eicher Motors**, **Tata Steel**, **Tube Investments**, **Anupam Rasayan**, **Juniper Hotels** and **Satia Industries**.

**Ice Make Refrigeration** — an investor update for the June quarter puts **year-on-year revenue growth at 60.4%**, a self-reported operating figure disclosed only in the attachment and not in the exchange subject line.

**Kalpataru Projects** also notes that with today's award its **year-to-date FY27 order intake has crossed Rs 11,000 crore** — a cumulative figure, and separate from the Rs 3,526 crore announced today.

**Tejas Cargo India — an aggregate is not an award.** Its **Rs 135.56 crore of new order value** is the total of **seven contract wins and renewals across April–July**, alongside a Chhattisgarh bauxite mining work order, 43 vehicles added and six new clients.
**Man Industries** — is added to **QatarEnergy's Preferred Manufacturers List** for LSAW pipes, coating and bends, which makes it an eligible bidder rather than the holder of an order.
distress_risk: **Pakka** — the auditors issue a **qualified opinion on the FY26 consolidated results** over the recoverability of **Rs 31.98 crore of capital work in progress** at an overseas subsidiary whose project may not resume.

**Bannari Amman Sugars** — re-files to BSE a **4 August disclosure it had omitted**, on recovery proceedings by the District Collector, Erode for **Rs 12.72 crore** of electricity tax and interest under the Tamil Nadu Act of 2003.

**Kalpataru Projects** — its Eswatini branch received a tax and penalty demand from the **Eswatini Revenue Service** over an alleged double claim of input VAT, the penalty component being **SZL 643,353.62, which the filing itself puts at about Rs 38.02 lakh**.
other_notable: **Baroda Rayon — the day's largest stored figure is an exceptional item.** Its **Rs 1,200 crore** at 408% of market value is the `Exceptional items 1,200.00` cell in a results table headed **`( in lakhs except EPS)`**, so **Rs 12.00 crore**, and not a deal.

**Transformers & Rectifiers — the price list is not the price.** The **Rs 1,000 crore** carried against its APTRANSCO order is the lower bound of the **Ultra-Mega** row in the filing's own order-size legend; the order itself is banded *Large*.
**MIC Electronics** — Brickwork lifts its bank facilities **from BWR BB/Stable to BWR BBB-/Stable**, and the guarantee line from A4+ to A3, on **Rs 110.82 crore** rated.
**Global Pet Industries** — approves a **buyback of up to 8,47,500 shares at Rs 160, Rs 13.56 crore**, being 7.19% of paid-up capital and **24.55% of capital and free reserves** _(~7.1% of mcap)_.

**Maha Rashtra Apex's Rs 14.09 crore** is a **Monitoring Agency Report** on a rights issue already raised, which is quarterly plumbing rather than an event, and **Om Freight Forwarders**, **Le Merite Exports**, **Dev Information Technology**, **Madhucon Projects**, **A B Infrabuild** and **Adisoft Technologies** filed press releases with no commercial terms.

tally: 2026-08-14: 4,251 announcements captured (00:00–23:59 IST) on a Friday results tape — **723 companies filed results or earnings-call material** — with 1,756 material rows → **8 verified movers**. The day belongs to defence and to capacity: **NIBE's Rs 563.35 crore contract with the Indian Army for 30 Vayuastra loitering-munition sets** is the largest genuine transaction and reached the store with no amount at all, while **Kalpataru Projects' Rs 3,526 crore of fresh awards** is the biggest by value and was demoted by a content flag that was simply wrong. **KMC Speciality commits Rs 486 crore to roughly 500 new beds at Trichy**, **Prakash Pipes Rs 100 crore to flexible packaging at Kashipur**, and **Vagus Def Tech puts up to Rs 200 crore into Texmaco's defence arm for 30%**. Smaller companies went to their own shareholders: **Viceroy Hotels fixed a Rs 105.83 crore rights issue** and **Bonlon Industries approved one worth 71.6% of its own market value**, while **Gandhi Special Tubes set the record date for a Rs 78.13 crore buyback**. Seven baseline movers failed, and the largest stored figure on the tape is the clearest: **Blue Cloud Softech's Rs 37,281 crore is Rs 372.81 crore with the decimal point OCR'd as a comma** — a completed April swap, recapped in a results note. **Transformers & Rectifiers' Rs 1,000 crore was read out of the order-size legend**, **TD Power Systems' Rs 600 crore is a per-share price**, **Baroda Rayon's Rs 1,200 crore an exceptional item in lakhs**, and **Adani Energy's Rs 8,500 crore a project value announced in July**.
